svg.title: It converges pointwise to ψ(x)K0(x). On the support use the moving limit and continuity of ψ; outside its closed support the rounded points are eventually outside it, so the expression vanishes. If ψ is supported in the radius-R ball, the step functions, for hm ≤1, are supported in the radius- R + 4n ball and are bounded by a common constant there. They are integrable step functions. Dominated convergence gives convergence of their integrals. Each grid cell has exactly volume h4n m . Summing the cells, with no wrapping on the fixed support, identifies the integral exactly with
